board.title: Requests
board.emptyTitle: This table is not asking for anything yet
board.emptyDescription: Publish a request to ask something of your candidates or your players. Publishing it notifies them.
board.closeDescription: It stops taking answers. What was already handed in stays and can still be read.

form.publishDescription: Publishing it notifies the people it is addressed to.
form.editDescription: Correcting it does not notify again: the notice goes out once, when it is published.
form.titleRequired: Give it a title: it is what shows in the notice and in the list.

audienceHint.Candidates: Anyone looking at the table sees it, even before applying. Candidates answer it.
audienceHint.Players: The players you have accepted see it and answer it.
audienceHint.Single: One person at your table sees it and answers it.

form.targetRequired: Pick the person you are asking.
form.targetNoPlayers: There are no accepted players at this table yet.
form.answerChannelRequired: Pick at least one way to answer.
form.dueHint: In your time zone ({{timeZone}}). Nothing happens when it passes — it is a reference.
form.mandatoryHint: It is only a label. It blocks nothing and removes nobody from the table.
form.publishedToast: Request published. Everyone has been notified.

submissions.title: Answers
submissions.emptyDescription: When somebody hands something in, it will show up here with whatever they sent.
submissions.missingHint: This list is information: not answering blocks nothing and removes nobody from the table.

applicable.title: What this table asks for
applicable.emptyTitle: This table is not asking anything of you
applicable.emptyDescription: When the master publishes a request that applies to you, it will show up here.
applicable.cannotAnswer: You will be able to answer this once you apply to the table.

submit.title: Answer: {{title}}
submit.description: What you send is added to what you sent before; nothing is replaced.
submit.accumulatesHint: Each answer is kept separately. If you already sent something, it stays.
